answer: Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. The design leans on time-locked work history, expired if not renewed by fresh work, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. Work waits on the oasis until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the whisper of the next round. Reaching the inlet of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys.
